rule.title: Five-Point Code Review Verification Checklist
rule.statement: Every Pull Request must be audited against 5 criteria before approval: Correctness, Security, Architecture Alignment, Test Coverage, and Readability.
rule.rationale: Ad-hoc reviews devolve into superficial debates over formatting while critical security vulnerabilities, regression risks, and architectural drift go unnoticed.
rule.implementation_guidance: Include a standardized PR template checklist covering all 5 dimensions. Ensure all CI quality gates pass before merge.

forbidden.example: Merging PRs with 'LGTM' without verifying tests or security boundaries.

preferred.example: PR checklist verified: [x] Unit/Integration Tests pass [x] No any types [x] Ownership filters verified [x] TSDoc added

source.evidence_quote: Code review evaluates design, functionality, complexity, tests, naming, comments, and style. The reviewer should ensure the code improves the codebase overall.
